scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives, each with a Bloom level, and each is assessed by at least 3 questions (o1: q0, q1, q2, q5; o2: q3, q6, q7; o3: q4, q9, q8). The rewritten q9 still has objectiveId o3 and bloom evaluate, and the stem 「AとBについて、いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？」 still asks for the o3 judgment. The exam includes the transfer items q5 (`config/production.yml`) and q8 (a Web-page-summarizing MCP server).

hook-problem sets out a concrete failure in 2 sentences (「CLAUDE.mdに「`.env` は編集しないこと」と書いたのに、Claudeが `.env` を書き換えようとしました。」) and adds a version line. hook-predict is ungraded, and option d (Manual) is a real near-miss. The q0 explanation now names 「第2回の拒否ルールのように」 as another mechanism.

The prerequisites list lessons 2, 6 and 7, jq and JSON editing, and s2-setup starts with `jq --version`. Earlier lessons are recalled in s1-lead (「第6回のとおり」「第2回の権限ルールやフック」) and s5-lead (「第7回のスキルやサブエージェントは」). The definitions blocks match the glossary word for word. One gap: `onFailure` appears in s3-pitfall without a gloss.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 1892 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2878 · practice reading 1249 · questions 10 · practice sections 1 · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and estMinutes 18 matches the estimate rounded. The q9 stem was about 190 characters and is now 「AJとBについて…」-free short form 「AとBについて、いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？」. The case details moved into practice-b-task as two list items, each one under the 160-character paragraph budget, with every sentence under 60 characters (for example 「ただし、そのフックは編集のたびに、外部から取ってきたスクリプトを実行します。」). lint --strict reports 0 warnings, so every block is within budget. Each practice screen pairs text with steps, a quiz or a table. Minor issues remain in unchanged blocks: 「許可ではない」 is said twice in s3.

The s2 worked example is still complete and now more precise. ex-test says 「下の③の最初の4行は1つのコマンドで」, which matches the reformatted s2-test (4 lines up to `.claude/hooks/block-rm.sh`, then `echo $?`). Its expect names what to swap (「`rm notes.txt` を `ls` に変えると `0` です」). The practice fades it with the same JSON layout (p-predict: 「`"command": "rm notes.txt"` は、`"file_path": ".env"` にします」).

There are inline checks in s1, s2, s3, s5 and the practice. The rewritten q9 is an evaluate item with crossed A×B options, and every wrong option has feedback: b 「社内製でも、課題には社外の人が書いた文章が混ざります。」, c 「閉じるツールは、権限ルールで外せます。」, d 「フックが外から取ってくるスクリプトは前もって確かめられません。」. The cases now sit in practice-b-task, directly above the quiz, together with the instruction 「8-5の表の項目ごとに書き出してから答えます」, so learners write out their analysis before choosing. The model tables (practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) come after the quiz, so they do not give the answer away. One soft spot remains: q3's answer b repeats the s3-table phrase.

All 6 misconceptions in the brief are corrected with a reason. The q9 options and feedback did not change. 「社内製なら安全」 is corrected in q9 b, and 「作者とソースがわかれば入れてよい」 in q9 d (「フックは権限ルールでも絞れません」). The other misconceptions are still handled: q0 a/b and q7 b (CLAUDE.md as a guarantee), q3 a/c and q5 b (exit 1 blocks), s3-zero (exit 0 is not approval), q6 b (PostToolUse undoes the edit), q2 a/b/d (the condition catches everything), and q4 d and q8 b (official means safe). Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer.

s1-lifecycle is a 6-node process diagram with Japanese labels that match the text. The edge 「通す（権限の確認へ）」 agrees with s3-table. The caption states the takeaway, and the alt text describes both paths. All tables have 2 columns, and there are no decorative images.

Part 1 is unchanged: it is authentic and faded, every step has an observable expect, the hint ladder runs from step hint to troubleshoot to model answer, and practice-checklist gives 5 success criteria. In part 2, practice-b-task now holds the full A/B case with a clear task (「8-5の表の項目ごとに書き出してから答えます」), and the q9 hint (「8-5の表の6項目を、AとBについて1つずつ埋めてから比べましょう」) fits it. The model write-ups practice-b-model and practice-b-model-b come after the quiz. Every fact in them appears in the new practice-b-task text, for example 「課題には社外の人も書き込めます」 maps to 「社外の人が書いた課題を読む」.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection question (「あなたのCLAUDE.mdで、本当は毎回必ず守らせたいルールはどれでしょう？」), the next lesson and a descriptive link. There are 7 flashcards, and card-before-install now lists the same six labels as s5-checks.

The change moves the text and adds no new claims. The A/B facts in practice-b-task are word for word the ones in the old q9 stem (「課題を読むツールと閉じるツールを持ち」「外部から取ってきたスクリプトを実行します」). The q9 explanation and feedback did not change, and they still agree with practice-b-model-b (「フックは権限ルールの外で動く」). The block keeps cite [cc-plugin-security, cc-mcp]. estMinutes 18 matches measure.mjs (est 17.8). All earlier audit findings stay fixed.

The new practice-b-task text uses です・ます throughout (「社内チームの課題管理MCPサーバーです」「スクリプトを実行します」), and the new q9 stem is a soft question (「どれでしょう？」). The terms match the rest of the lesson: 「権限ルール」 and 「全部入り」 also appear in practice-b-model-b, and 「8-5の表」 points to s5-checks. There are no banned phrases. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The only locale (jp) is complete, the diagram labels are in Japanese, the alt text covers both paths, and the link text is descriptive (「フックの公式ガイド（日本語）」). Plain-text fields (checklist labels, captions, prompt) carry no markdown, for example 「cat .envで」 and 「.envの末尾に」.

niceToHave: practice-b-quiz q9 (changed block, order unchanged): the correct option a comes first in array order, and so does the answer to q7 (check-quiz). The reader shows options in array order, so move q9 option a to the third position (array order b, c, a, d) to spread the answer positions.

s4-add (unchanged): the comment reads `# claude mcp add <名前> -- <コマンド>`, but the s4 prose says 「`--` の後に起動コマンドを書きます」. If the code width allows, change it to "# claude mcp add <名前> -- <起動コマンド>" so the two use the same term.
s3-check q3 (unchanged): option b repeats the s3-table phrase 「hook error」, so a learner can pick it by that phrase alone. Set option b md to "フックでは止まらず、ふだんの権限の確認へ進む".

s4 (unchanged): no objective or question covers scopes, yet summary-points[2] and card-scopes are about them. Either tie scopes to o3 with a q8 distractor about committing to `.mcp.json` at `project` scope before trying the server at `local` scope, or cut summary point 3 to "MCPサーバーも、入れる前に確かめてからスコープを選んで追加します。".
s3-zero (unchanged): it repeats the table cell 「（許可ではない）」. Change the s3-table cell to "進む。表示はなく、ふだんの権限の確認へ".
s3-pitfall (unchanged): gloss `onFailure` on first use: "…`onFailure`（失敗したときの扱いを決める設定）を `\"block\"` にしたフックなどでは、失敗でも止まります。"
check-quiz q8 (unchanged): add "`.mcp.json` に書かれる起動コマンドやURLも、入れる前に読みます。" to the explanation, so q8 also names what runs, which q4 taught as the first check.
summary: Verification round: review-scope.mjs exited 0 (2 of 49 blocks and 1 lesson field changed, 4%). The previous review had no open must-fix items, so `resolved` is empty. This round applies the earlier niceToHave on q9: the A/B case moved from the roughly 190-character stem into practice-b-task as two list items, and the stem is now 「AとBについて、いちばん適切な判断はどれでしょう？」. I reviewed both changed blocks in full and found no errors. The facts carried over word for word, the options and feedback did not change, the model tables still come after the quiz, and every sentence is within budget. estMinutes is now 18, which matches measure.mjs (est 17.8). validate and lint --strict are clean. I raised load from 3 to 4 because every block is now within budget. Every criterion is 3 or higher, and the mean is 3.85.
